name: Tailfin-Era Car
summary: The big American car of the jet age. A long, low body with tail fins, a wide chrome grille, a wrap-around windscreen and two-tone paint. The cabin has bright vinyl and cloth.

philosophy.core_thesis: After the war a car shows plenty: each year it is longer, lower and brighter, with a fin and chrome that copy the jet aircraft.
design_principles: Raise a tail fin at the rear wing, from 5 cm in 1948 to 30 cm in 1959.
Widen the grille to the full width of the car, in a bar of chrome with bright teeth.
Curve the windscreen round the corners to give a wrap-around view.
Paint the body in two tones, split by a chrome spear along the flank.
Fit bumpers with bullet-shaped guards, and set the tail lamps in the fin.
Make the interior bright, with vinyl in a woven pattern, nylon cloth and an aluminium dashboard trim.
Change the body each year, so that a new model looks longer and lower than the last.
anti_patterns: A plain, upright body with no fin
A body in one dull colour

silhouette.shape: A long, low, wide car with a flat bonnet, a wrap-around windscreen, a thin roof and a tail with a fin at each rear wing.
silhouette.line: A horizontal body line that rises in the rear wing into a fin, and a chrome spear along the flank.
silhouette.fit: A bench seat for six, with the occupants low in a wide, soft cabin; the doors are long and the roof is thin.
silhouette.proportion: Length 5.2 to 5.8 m; height 1.3 to 1.4 m; fin height up to 30 cm. The bonnet and the boot are both long and flat.
rules: Set the fin at the rear wing, with a tail lamp in or under it.
Fit a grille of the full width, with chrome bars and bullet guards.
Split the body into two or three paint tones along a chrome line.
Put a dart or a spear of chrome on the flank, from the front wheel to the fin.

fabrics.rule: Use a lot of bright material. Use pressed steel in big panels, chrome in bars, vinyl and nylon in bright patterns, and acrylic for lamp lenses and trim.

methods: deep-draw pressed steel fins and wings
full-size clay model by the styling studio
chrome plating of bars and guards
woven vinyl and nylon seat covers
construction.closures: Push-button door handles, a wide boot lid with a chrome crest, and a hardtop roof without a pillar.
construction.details: Bullet bumper guards, twin headlamps, tail fins with lamps, a chrome spear on the flank, a wrap-around screen and a hood ornament.

surface.pattern: Two-tone or three-tone body; woven vinyl in a diamond or a stripe in the cabin, and a bright cloth insert.
surface.gloss: Enamel and lacquer at 80–90 GU; chrome at more than 90 GU; brushed aluminium trim at 20–40 GU.
surface.wear: Chrome pits and the vinyl cracks; the lacquer fades; owners polish the chrome and re-spray the two-tone line.

palette.strategy: Bright, pastel and strong colours in two or three tones, with a mass of chrome, and a cabin that matches the body colour.

making.scale: Mass-made by a few big makers, up to a million cars of a line a year; a new body style each year.
making.signs: A fin at the rear wing, a full-width chrome grille, a wrap-around screen and a two-tone body split by a chrome line.

pieces.form: Long four-door saloon with fins and a chrome spear
Pillarless hardtop coupe with a wrap-around windscreen
Full-width chrome grille with bullet guards
Wide bench seat in woven vinyl with a cloth insert
Padded dashboard with an aluminium trim panel and a wide speedometer
Long wagon with fins and a wood-effect side panel

emotion.target_response: A sense of plenty and speed: the viewer sees chrome, pastel colour and a fin that points at the sky.

use_cases: a 1950s film or an American diner scene
a retro poster or a neon sign scene
an image prompt for a fifties car
a design history lesson on styling
avoid_when: the brief wants a quiet, refined car
the brief wants a European sports coupe
the brief wants a small, light car

modifiers.how: Remove the fins, shorten the body, keep the long bonnet and add a bold stripe and a V8 look.
Remove the fins and the chrome, lower the roof and keep one thin chrome line.

ornament_level.note: Chrome and fins are the point; the style is the most ornamented of the car styles.
